title: Cyrus and the Cellar
author: Xanthe Vane
blurb: Edmund Quintana, a property surveyor appraising a house that appraises back, has spent ten years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the family out ahead of the count before the well refills.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
